description: A gray plastic tub with several clear ice cubes sits on the table, with a small yellow cup to its left and a purple scoop to the right. The right hand lifts the purple scoop, dips it into the tub to gather ice, then moves left and tilts the scoop to dump the ice into the yellow cup while the left hand slides in to steady and hold the cup; afterward the right hand pulls the scoop away and sets it back down to the right.
